source: due2-native: a DPROD duty whose bearer is a string literal (follow-up review F06, #124)
notes: Not valid ODRL 2.2: dprod:subjectOfDuty is rdfs:subPropertyOf odrl:function, whose range is odrl:Party, so its value is a resource (IM 2.3, 2.6). Admission and odrl22-shape.ttl read the function and relation properties from the vocabularies rather than from a list, so a profile's own party roles are covered. Read as a name, "Alice" would bear a duty that no evidence could fulfil, because an evidence actor is an Id, an IRI (due2-workflows.md §2; schema/collections.schema.json). dprod:agent, which has range odrl:Party but is not a sub-property of odrl:function, is outside the check: it is a property of a DPROD EvaluationContext, never of a policy.

expected_rejection.why: ex:report's dprod:subjectOfDuty is the literal "Alice", and a sub-property of odrl:function takes a Party, a resource (IM 2.3, 2.6; decisions/0034). W1 rejects the policy in stage 1.
